title: A user with only View sees no Inventory actions menu
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Staff member {User-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL-VIEWONLY) works at {Location-A} with the custom role {Role-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-VIEWONLY-ROLE), which has only 'Part Library & Inventory → View' (no Create & Edit, no Delete, no See Financial Data and no Settings permission).
  • {User-C} is signed in in a second browser window (for example a private window), and the Admin stays signed in in the first window.
custom_steps:
1. In {User-C}'s window open Parts → Inventory on the Active tab.
  2. Look at the toolbar for the ⋮ actions menu button.
  3. Click the Inactive tab.
  4. Look at the toolbar again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: The Inventory list opens and shows parts: viewing the list still works with View only.
  • Step 2: There is no ⋮ actions menu button, so no Cycle count, Export, Deactivate parts or Activate parts can be reached.
  • Step 4: There is no ⋮ actions menu button on the Inactive tab either.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S8-R5, S8-R13, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.1 (The actions menu), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Story SV-10821 acceptance criterion on a user with only View agrees. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R5: “The actions menu needs the 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' permission. Its Cycle count and Export entries need nothing more. Only the bulk status entry also needs the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission.”
  • S8-R13: “Editing pricing, editing bin quantities and viewing the Inventory list follow the permissions that already govern them.”
  • SV-10821 acceptance criteria: “Given a user with only View, when they open the Inventory list, then no actions menu is shown.”
